{{Short description|Special numbers in mathematics}}
In [[mathematics]],  '''Eisenstein–Kronecker numbers''' are an analogue for [[imaginary quadratic field]]s of [[generalized Bernoulli numbers]].<ref name="BK1">{{Citation | last1=Bannai | first1=Kenichi | last2=Kobayashi | first2=Shinichi | editor1-last=Hashimoto | editor1-first=Kiichiro | title=Proceedings of the Symposium on Algebraic Number Theory and Related Topics | arxiv=0709.0640 | publisher=[[Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences|Res. Inst. Math. Sci. (RIMS), Kyoto]] | series=RIMS Kôkyuroku Bessatsu, B4 | mr=2402003 | year=2007 | chapter=Algebraic theta functions and Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers | pages=63–77| bibcode=2007arXiv0709.0640B }}</ref><ref>{{Citation | last1=Bannai | first1=Kenichi | last2=Kobayashi | first2=Shinichi | last3=Tsuji | first3=Takeshi | editor1-last=Asada | editor1-first=Mamoru | editor2-last=Nakamura | editor2-first=Hiroaki | editor3-last=Takahashi | editor3-first=Hiroki | title=Algebraic number theory and related topics 2007 | publisher=[[Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences|Res. Inst. Math. Sci. (RIMS), Kyoto]] | series=RIMS Kôkyuroku Bessatsu, B12 | mr=2605771 | year=2009 | chapter=Realizations of the elliptic polylogarithm for CM elliptic curves | pages=33–50}}</ref><ref name="Charollois-Sczech">{{Cite journal |last=Charollois |first=Pierre |last2=Sczech |first2=Robert |year=2016 |title=Elliptic Functions According to Eisenstein and Kronecker: An Update |url=http://www.ems-ph.org/doi/10.4171/NEWS/101/4 |journal=[[European Mathematical Society|EMS]] Newsletter |language=en |volume=2016-9 |issue=101 |pages=8–14 |doi=10.4171/NEWS/101/4 |issn=1027-488X|doi-access=free }}</ref> They are defined in terms of classical Eisenstein–Kronecker series, which were studied by Kenichi Bannai and Shinichi Kobayashi using the [[Poincaré bundle]].<ref name="Charollois-Sczech"/><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Sprang |first=Johannes |year=2019 |title=Eisenstein–Kronecker Series via the Poincaré bundle |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/product/identifier/S205050941900029X/type/journal_article |journal=[[Forum of Mathematics, Sigma]] |language=en |volume=7 |pages=e34 |doi=10.1017/fms.2019.29 |issn=2050-5094|doi-access=free |arxiv=1801.05677 }}</ref>

Eisenstein–Kronecker numbers are [[algebraic number|algebraic]] and satisfy [[Modular arithmetic|congruences]] that can be used in the construction of two-variable [[p-adic L-function|''p''-adic ''L''-functions]].<ref name="Charollois-Sczech"/><ref name="BK2">{{Cite journal |last=Bannai |first=Kenichi |last2=Kobayashi |first2=Shinichi |year=2010 |title=Algebraic theta functions and the p-adic interpolation of Eisenstein-Kronecker numbers |url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/duke-mathematical-journal/volume-153/issue-2/Algebraic-theta-functions-and-the-p-adic-interpolation-of-Eisenstein/10.1215/00127094-2010-024.full |journal=[[Duke Mathematical Journal]] |volume=153 |issue=2 |doi=10.1215/00127094-2010-024 |issn=0012-7094|arxiv=math/0610163 }}</ref> They are related to critical ''L''-values of [[Hecke character]]s.<ref name="BK1"/><ref name="BK2"/>

==Definition==
When {{mvar|A}} is the area of the fundamental domain of <math>\Gamma</math> divided by <math>\pi</math>, where <math>\Gamma</math> is a lattice in <math>\mathbb{C}</math>:<ref name="BK2"/>
<math display="block">e_{a,b}^{*}(z_0,w_0):=\sum_{\gamma\in\Gamma\setminus\{-z_0\}}\frac{(\bar{z_0}+\bar{\gamma})^a}{(z_0+\gamma)^b}\langle\gamma,w_0\rangle_\Gamma,</math>
when <math>\mathbb{N}_0:=\mathbb{N}\cup\{0\},
\,\{a,b\in\mathbb{N}_0:b > a+2\},\,z_0,w_0\in\mathbb{C},</math>
<br>where <math>\langle z,w\rangle_\Gamma:=e^\frac{z\overline{w}-w\overline{z}}{A}</math> and <math>\overline{z}</math> is the [[complex conjugate]] of {{mvar|z}}.
